run_Demo_graph: run the Demo graph that generates random noise, averages it, and displays a real-time bar plot
create_NoiseGenerator_node: create a NoiseGenerator node that publishes random noise data to a single output topic at a configured sample rate
create_RollingAverager_node: create a RollingAverager node that averages incoming messages over a configurable time window
create_AveragedNoise_group: create an AveragedNoise group that combines a NoiseGenerator and RollingAverager into a single reusable component
create_Plot_node: create a Plot node that subscribes to data messages and renders a real-time matplotlib bar graph
